change: Only embed_head parameters retain requires_grad; other parameters are held constant for autograd
reason: Only the requested partial derivatives (embed_head parameters and key embeddings) are measured. This avoids retaining unnecessary backbone graphs for batch16 on V100; no forward values, loss function, train mode, samples or weights are changed.

change: Initial run did not call roi_proto_start_stage, causing APR candidate collection to warn on empty history
reason: APR is not part of either measured association loss. This cell retains its prespecified 20 batches and all association gradients; subsequent cells initialize the empty APR collection buffers explicitly.

change: Report loss-key activation separately from key RoI sample threshold
reason: The implementation emits loss_track_trim even when key RoIs <96; in this case key trim is identity but reference trim may still be active. Loss computation and effective key shrinkage are distinct events in the implementation, so both are reported.

change: Use native frozen inference via equivalent Python evaluation wrapper with metric bbox+track and all-frame HOTA correction
reason: The historical F/HF reference numbers use all-frame HOTA; the original repository default indexes only frames containing GT and must be corrected for exact parity. Detector .05, tracker .30/.20, fusion, classes, image sizes and tracker logic are preserved. F original runtime configs are read-only because configs/mot is absent from commit ebc3190.

change: Use one archived HF stage3 rank0 APR history identically in all four groups and ranks
reason: Original rank-local APR histories are available. This fixes a shared starting library across groups, with its SHA256 recorded; no rebuild needed.

change: Replace HF run-root audit hook with local audit hook, retain finite-loss and EMA hooks; keep find_unused_parameters=True as actual HF training
reason: Prevents writes to the original HF directory; the generic seq3 script otherwise overrides this HF execution setting.

change: After a group finishes both evaluations, remove only its generated epoch1 and stage00 source copies; retain epoch2, final endpoint and stage3 starting copy
reason: Storage was limited when the run was prepared (about 18 GiB free). This does not change training or reported checkpoints and avoids accumulating redundant weights. No other task files are modified.

change: Independent read-only SSHFS session under this run, exposed through private data_views symlinks to the same original image files
reason: Shared NAS mount briefly returned ENOTCONN during both X2 baselines. Existing completed video predictions were retained; incomplete videos are retried with the same inputs. No shared mount or image files were modified.

change: First F beta0 used cuDNN benchmark=False and found a small mismatch with archived metrics; F beta1 was held until the discrepancy was investigated
reason: The archived F command explicitly uses cuDNN benchmark=True. A separate corrected full-domain run used this setting, with the same discrepancy. The first baseline and all mismatch metrics are preserved. The archival F reference only lists OVERALL and car, so parity is checked for those available categories. HF has all six categories and passes all of them.

change: Corrected full-domain F beta0 still differed from the historical frozen scores; F beta1 was paused until the user approved the current-environment paired baseline
reason: Restoring cuDNN benchmark=True left the reported metrics unchanged. Disabled intervention output is bitwise identical to the native class, yet archived detections already differ slightly before association. A cross-runtime numerical difference or historical provenance gap remains possible, not established. All results and parity deltas are retained; no values are adjusted to match the archive.

change: Use the current V100 F beta0 as the paired intervention baseline in both domains; keep the archived F discrepancy table
reason: User explicitly approved this on 2026-10-29 after the corrected full-domain baseline still differed by +0.042 HOTA / +0.115 IDF1 / +0.107 AssA. Metrics are never altered to force historical equality. HF retains its exact historical-baseline gate.
